## 更新内容

### 设置页改为左侧导航

- 设置页拆成 5 个分区：外观、歌词与播放、桌面歌词、实验、Cider 连接。左侧导航切换，右侧一次只显示一个分区，切换时回到顶部。
- 打开设置页时保留上次选中的分区。从桌面歌词窗口点「设置」会直接打开「桌面歌词」分区。
- 窗口宽度小于 720 时导航只显示图标，悬停显示提示。设置页最大宽度调到 1400，右侧卡片比之前略宽。

### 桌面歌词渲染与字体

- 桌面歌词设置的「字样」新增字体选择，默认 Segoe UI，缺字时自动回退。
- 日文歌词使用日文字形渲染，中文歌词和译文使用中文字形；竖排时标点和长音符使用竖排字形。
- 前奏和无同步歌词时显示歌曲信息：双行模式为歌名与“歌手 · 专辑”，单行模式为“歌名 - 歌手”。
- 逐字模式下每秒刷新只更新扫色进度，不再重排整个窗口。

### 桌面歌词缩放与动画

- 改用系统原生缩放，四条边和四个角都可以拖动；拖动时边角显示缩放指示器。窗口不会被拖出工作区，宽 320–1200、高最大 480。
- 只拖左右边时高度随换行自动调整；双击上下边恢复自动高度。
- 锁定、解锁时背景、工具栏和解锁图标渐变过渡；解锁按钮改为白底深色图标的圆形按钮。系统关闭动画时直接切换。
- 背景改为铺满窗口，与缩放范围一致。开启背景时，背景比之前宽 24px、高 8px。

## 安装与升级

下载 `Lyrider_1.7.0.0_x64.msix` 和 `Lyrider.cer`，仅支持 Windows 11 x64。首次安装前，将证书导入当前用户的“受信任人”存储，再安装 MSIX：

```powershell
Import-Certificate -FilePath .\Lyrider.cer -CertStoreLocation Cert:\CurrentUser\TrustedPeople
Add-AppxPackage .\Lyrider_1.7.0.0_x64.msix
```

已有版本使用同一证书签名时，可直接安装新 MSIX 升级。安装包包含 .NET、Windows App SDK 运行时和中英文资源。Cider 插件 `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` 与 v1.6.1 相同，已安装的无需更新。

## 验证

- Release 构建 0 警告 0 错误；逻辑及服务测试（Release）：394/394 通过。
- 任务栏控件测试（Release）：76/76 通过，新增桌面歌词渲染、原生缩放、渐变动画相关测试。

完整变更：[v1.6.3...v1.7.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.3...v1.7.0)

## Changes in English

### Settings page with side navigation

- Settings are now split into five sections: Appearance, Lyrics and Playback, Desktop lyrics, Experimental and Cider Connection. A navigation list on the left switches sections, and the right side shows one section at a time, scrolled to the top.
- The last selected section is kept when Settings reopens. Clicking "Settings" in the desktop lyrics window opens the Desktop lyrics section directly.
- Below 720px window width the navigation shows icons only, with tooltips on hover. The maximum page width is now 1400, so cards are slightly wider than before.

### Desktop lyrics rendering and fonts

- A new font picker in the desktop lyrics Typography settings, defaulting to Segoe UI with fallback for missing glyphs.
- Japanese lyrics render with Japanese glyph forms, Chinese lyrics and translations with Chinese forms. Vertical layout uses vertical forms for punctuation and the long vowel mark.
- During the intro and for unsynced lyrics, song info is shown: title and "Artist · Album" in two-line mode, "Title - Artist" in single-line mode.
- In word-by-word mode the per-second refresh only updates the highlight progress instead of relaying out the whole window.

### Desktop lyrics resizing and animations

- Resizing now uses the native system loop on all four edges and corners, with resize indicators while dragging. The window stays inside the work area, between 320 and 1200 wide and up to 480 high.
- Dragging only the left or right edge keeps automatic height that follows line wrapping; double-clicking the top or bottom edge restores automatic height.
- Locking and unlocking fade the background, toolbar and unlock icon. The unlock button is now a round white button with a dark icon. Transitions switch instantly when system animations are off.
- The background now fills the whole window to match the resize area, so with the background on it is 24px wider and 8px taller than before.

### Installation and verification

Download `Lyrider_1.7.0.0_x64.msix` and `Lyrider.cer` for Windows 11 x64. For a first installation, import the certificate into the current user's Trusted People store using the commands above, then install the MSIX. Existing installations signed with the same certificate can upgrade directly. The Cider plugin `Lyrider-Cider-Plugin_1.0.0.zip` is unchanged from v1.6.1.

The Release build had no warnings or errors. All 394 logic/service tests and all 76 taskbar widget tests, including new tests for desktop lyrics rendering, native resizing and fade animations, passed.

Full changelog: [v1.6.3...v1.7.0](https://github.com/Ayor1337/Lyrider/compare/v1.6.3...v1.7.0)
